## Ingredients

* 1 cup of shredded or chopped chicken breast in your favorite bbq sauce
* Nacho chips or tortilla chips, enough to cover a pan
* BBQ sauce
* Cheddar cheese

## Directions

* Put a layer of chips down on a sheet pan or cookie sheet, probably on parchment paper or aluminum foil
* Put your chicken over the chips
* Drizzle BBQ sauce on top of the chicken and chips
* Finally, shred some cheddar cheese over that. You typically don't want as much cheese as you might use for regular nachos.
